categories.main_business_segments: Yonker Environmental Protection Co., Ltd. primarily operates in environmental protection and new energy sectors. Its main business segments include soil remediation, hazardous waste disposal, air pollution control, environmental consulting and testing, waste-to-energy (waste incineration power generation), photovoltaic power generation, wind power, energy storage, and carbon neutrality consulting services. The company integrates engineering and operation services with a focus on pollution control, carbon reduction, and renewable energy asset management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as selective catalytic reduction (SCR) for flue gas denitrification, innovative soil remediation materials and methods including heavy metal stabilization and bio-fixation, intelligent automated production systems for remediation agents, and digital management platforms for carbon assets and energy systems. It also develops integrated waste incineration and energy recovery technologies, photovoltaic and energy storage system design and operation, and smart grid and multi-energy complementary technologies. The company emphasizes R&D in pollution control, renewable energy integration, and digitalization of environmental services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yonker serves a broad range of customers including government entities, industrial enterprises in steel, power, chemical, and non-ferrous metals sectors, municipal waste management authorities, and commercial clients in industrial parks and public institutions. Its markets cover environmental remediation, hazardous waste treatment, renewable energy generation and operation, and carbon management services. The company also extends services internationally to regions including the United States, Indonesia, Canada, and South Korea.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a strong presence in Hunan Province and expanding operations in economically developed regions such as Guangdong, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Jiangxi provinces. It also has subsidiaries and projects in overseas markets including the United States, Singapore, and Indonesia. Its service footprint covers over 32 provinces and more than 80 cities and counties domestically.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yonker operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental and renewable energy supply chain. It provides engineering design, construction, operation, and maintenance services for environmental remediation and renewable energy projects. The company also engages in resource recovery and recycling, carbon asset management, and consulting, positioning itself as an integrated service provider from technology development to asset operation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on becoming a leading operator of high-quality new energy assets and an innovator in pollution reduction and carbon neutrality technologies. It prioritizes R&D in soil remediation materials, waste-to-energy technologies, digital carbon management platforms, multi-energy complementary systems, and intelligent control systems for emissions and energy efficiency. Yonker actively explores the integration of AI and big data to enhance operational efficiency and expand into emerging business models such as waste incineration combined with data centers.
categories.revenue_model: Yonker generates revenue primarily through service contracts including environmental operation services, engineering construction contracts, environmental consulting and testing services, and BOT (Build-Operate-Transfer) project revenues. It also earns income from renewable energy asset investments and operations such as waste incineration power plants, photovoltaic and wind power projects, and energy storage facilities. Additional revenue streams include government subsidies, carbon asset development, and financial income from investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yonker is positioned as a leading comprehensive environmental protection and new energy service provider in China, especially strong in soil remediation, hazardous waste treatment, and waste-to-energy sectors. It competes with other domestic environmental engineering and energy companies but differentiates itself through integrated technology innovation, extensive project experience, and a diversified business model combining engineering and asset operation. The company holds a competitive edge in digital carbon management and multi-energy integration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Yonker reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 760 million, representing a 17.7% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 98 million, up 23.1%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 3.55 billion, with steady growth in net assets and cash flow from operations. Despite challenges in some traditional environmental segments, the company’s new energy and carbon-related businesses showed rapid growth, doubling revenue in the new energy segment. Yonker maintains a positive growth trajectory supported by strategic investments and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yonker emphasizes its comprehensive one-stop environmental and new energy solutions combining advanced core technologies, integrated engineering and operational capabilities, and strong R&D innovation. Its value proposition lies in delivering high-efficiency pollution control, resource recovery, and renewable energy asset management with digital and intelligent enhancements. The company’s unique integration of environmental remediation with new energy and carbon services, supported by national policy alignment and extensive project experience, differentiates it as a technology leader and reliable partner in China’s green transition.
